name: BoomTown
positioning: Lead generation sold with the accountability layer that forces a team to actually work the leads.
description: BoomTown pairs a consumer search site and paid lead generation with a CRM designed around team management — predictive lead scoring, an opportunity wall and, historically, a human ISA service that qualifies leads before they reach an agent. Now part of MoxiWorks.
real_estate_use: Chosen by teams that buy leads at volume and struggle to convert them. The system ranks which contacts deserve a call today, escalates when an agent ignores an assignment, and reports on the funnel from lead to appointment to closing so a team leader can act on the gap rather than on anecdote.
features: Consumer IDX search site with lead capture
Predictive lead scoring and prioritised call lists
Success Assurance ISA service qualifying leads before agent handoff
Automated drip and text campaigns per lead behaviour
Team accountability dashboards from lead to appointment

use_cases.job: Convert bought leads at a measurable rate with enforced agent follow-up
Start the day with a ranked call list instead of an undifferentiated database
